content: Sigma.js v3 browser graph rendering: new Sigma(graph, container, settings) where graph is a graphology Graph. nodeReducer/edgeReducer receive (key, data) and return Partial<NodeDisplayData/EdgeDisplayData>. renderer.on('clickNode', ({node}) => {}) for selection. Use circular.assign(graph) then forceAtlas2.assign(graph, { iterations: N }) for force layout.

graphology directed Graph construction: new Graph({ type: 'directed', multi: false }). addEdge(src, tgt, attrs) wraps duplicate errors in try/catch. outNeighbors/inNeighbors for BFS blast radius. getNodeAttribute(id, key) returns unknown — cast to string. Check hasNode() before accessing.

Sigma.js v3 dark-theme config: labelColor:{color:'#e2e8f0'}, defaultEdgeType:'arrow'+EdgeArrowProgram, custom defaultDrawNodeHover using dark fill (#1a1d27) instead of #FFF, nodeReducer sets label:null for dimmed nodes to hide labels during selection/search.

Lazy function node expansion in Sigma.js: on file click in Fn mode, fetch /api/functions?file=<path>, add nodes via engine.addFunctionNodes() with cluster positioning (radius=80, evenly spaced angles), fall back to language-aware mock data on 404/network error, collapse with graph.dropNode() which auto-removes edges. Track expanded state with Map<fileId, fnNodeIds[]>.

Pro license gate pattern: store key in localStorage('xray_pro_key'), check before Fn mode activation. Modal overlay with input; on submit, store key and activate mode. Backend should return 402 when license invalid; frontend shows modal on 402. Any non-empty key accepted in M3 (real validation in M4).

lightenColor(hex, factor): blend hex color toward white by factor (0-1). Used for function nodes to inherit parent file's language color at 50% lighter shade. Implementation: blend each RGB channel toward 255.

DEV_MODE bypass pattern for Pro gate: add 'const DEV_MODE = true' at top of main.ts; wrap gate checks with '\!DEV_MODE &&'; skip license param in fetch URLs when DEV_MODE; ignore 402 responses when DEV_MODE. Backend /api/functions has no license gate.

expandFileNode() in web/src/main.ts must transform the /api/functions response { file, functions, classes } into FunctionInfo[] by: mapping functions to kind='Function' with id=fileId+'::'+name, mapping classes to kind='Class', and using c.callee for calls. Direct cast as FunctionInfo[] silently fails.

AI export JSON format (SPEC §7): AiExportJson struct has xray_export_version:u8, exported_at, root, query:{from,depth,direction}, summary:{node_count,edge_count,languages,entry_node:{id,path,exports}}, nodes, edges, dependency_order. Serialize via serde_json::to_string_pretty.

License key format XRAY-XXXX-XXXX: two 4-char alphanumeric segments after prefix. Stored at ~/.xray/license.key via dirs::home_dir(). dirs crate v5 uses getpwuid_r on macOS (ignores HOME env var), so license path tests must use direct fs helpers, not env::set_var.

Cycle detection in Sigma.js web UI: Tarjan SCC in engine.ts (detectCycles/getCycleNodes/getCycleEdges), cycleNodes/cycleEdges in HighlightState, cycle panel via dynamic DOM in panels.ts (no index.html edits needed). Cycle count badge in #graph-stats, floating panel at bottom-right. graphology edge() returns string|undefined—always null-check.

Orphan highlight pattern: detectOrphans() in engine returns in-degree-0 non-function nodes (cached). UI toggles via stat counter click → orphanNodes: Set<string>|null in HighlightState, amber #f59e0b color.

Directory grouping panel: getDirectoryGroups() groups file nodes by dir prefix, getInterModuleEdges() counts cross-dir edges. Panel id=directory-panel toggled via #dir-group-btn with cyan #06b6d4 highlight.
Annotation editor: tag chips with remove buttons, text input+Add, Save callback. Panel id=annotation-editor positioned above #annotate-btn. engine.setAnnotation(nodeId, {tags}) for persistence.

Snapshot export: generateSnapshotHTML embeds graph JSON + sigma/graphology CDN links. triggerDownload creates Blob URL and clicks hidden anchor. Dropdown id=export-dropdown shown/hidden via Export button.

Annotation persistence pattern: engine.setAnnotation() must fire-and-forget fetch PUT /api/annotations with the full annotations map after updating in-memory state. Backend NodeAnnotation uses {team,domain,status,tags} while frontend AnnotationData uses {tags,status,owner,label} — loadAnnotations() maps team→owner, domain→label on load.
